widgets_values: A cinematic full-body hero reveal of a colossal NINE-HEADED water-serpent resentment beast (Chinese myth Xiangliu / 相柳 form) RISING out of West Lake at night, the entire creature visible, shot from a slightly LOW ANGLE looking up at its monumental scale against the misty night sky, the distant Leifeng Pagoda glowing faint warm amber far behind in the fog. [FORM - CRITICAL] The beast is formed from the drowned grievance-souls of nine clans sunk in the lake for 800 years. EXACTLY NINE giant heads, clearly countable, fanned out across the frame on nine long necks. Each head is the face of a long-DROWNED ancient corpse (Southern-Song era): bloated waterlogged rotting flesh in sickly green-black (#2B3B2E / #1E2A22), wet matted black hair clinging to the skull, hollow empty eye sockets WEEPING BLACK WATER (#07100D), jaws hanging open in a frozen underwater WAIL. The nine necks are made of WATER-AND-BONE - translucent dark lake water with human vertebrae and drowned skeletons visible suspended inside - braiding and coiling downward into ONE massive serpentine body half-submerged in the black lake. Countless TRANSLUCENT cold cyan-white grievance-spirit wraiths (#B6C7C4) swirl and cling around the heads and body - semi-transparent drowned souls, faint faces and reaching hands barely visible through them, the night fog visible through their bodies. 【CONSTRAINTS】the head count is EXACTLY NINE - not 8, not 10, not a vague many; must read clearly as nine. It reads as a nine-headed grievance serpent (Xiangliu), NOT a western dragon, NOT an octopus, NOT a hydra lizard, NOT a generic kaiju, NO wings, NO horns. Necks are water + visible bone, NOT solid muscular flesh. Wraiths are TRANSLUCENT and ghostly, NOT solid opaque figures. Heads are rotting DROWNED CORPSE faces, NOT clean white bone skulls, NOT living dragon heads. 【PHOTOGRAPHIC TONE】Cinematic LOW-SATURATION misty night, monumental horror per the locked color bible: cold deep teal-blue (#0B1B23 / #13262F) over a black lake, heavy green-grey fog (#4A5A4C / #2B3B2E) rolling across the water, cold pale teal moonlight (#354D57) catching the wet rotting heads, distant warm amber pagoda glow (#D9A441) as the only warm note deep in the fog; the ghost wraiths glow cold cyan-white (#B6C7C4), luminous and semi-transparent. Desaturated, oppressive, vast monumental scale, dread; image clean and sharp, NOT noisy; shadows fall to deep teal-green (#1E333D), not crushed pure black. 【Avoid】wrong head count (eight / seven / ten / countless heads), cute or cartoon dragon, friendly creature, western dragon with wings, octopus tentacles, clean white bone skulls, living reptile heads, solid opaque ghosts, high saturation / vivid candy colours / clean bright look, any red, daytime, clear blue sky, film grain / photo noise over the image, plastic CGI look, text, watermark, logo. size 16:9, quality 4K
